document_title: TLC VACATIONS LLP — Hotel API scenarios
scope: Hotel API only — first integration phase
document_type: Scenario specification with illustrative API request templates
format_note: This is a JSON scenario pack, not executed request/response logs or certification evidence. All {{...}} values require replacement and type resolution. TBO must confirm the entitled endpoint family and payloads before any request is sent.

common_test_setup.execution_date_rule: D is the actual agreed execution date; calculate check-in D+30 and check-out D+35 each run.
common_test_setup.availability: TBO must nominate bookable staging inventory; these cities and dates are candidates.
common_test_setup.nationality: IN unless a scenario overrides it
common_test_setup.credentials: Not included; provide securely outside the pack
common_test_setup.booking_approval: Consultant approval required before a controlled supplier booking
common_test_setup.variant_rule: Run each listed positive/negative variation independently and record its execution mode.

required_confirmations: Confirm TLC's entitled hotel API family, versions and separate staging URLs for every method; map any Room/Block terminology to the supplied contract.
Confirm hotel account entitlement, static-content versus hotel credentials, per-service authorization and approved egress IPs. Supply secrets through the agreed secure channel.
Provide current city/hotel codes, available test dates, sufficient test credit and TBO-approved synthetic guest/contact/document fixtures.
Resolve the public documentation differences: Search child ages versus Book acceptance, NetAmount scalar versus array wording, and the hold/voucher field names.
Confirm pending-state polling, expiry, retry limits and lookup after a lost Book response. Confirm whether client-reference reconciliation is available for this account.
Mark partial cancellation, amendments, special requests and any unsupported capability explicitly; supply the supported alternative and fixture owner/delivery date.

HOTEL_BOOKING: Resolve current hotel codes and details
Authorize each service with its agreed account credentials
Search for the exact stay and room occupancy
Review current amount, restrictions and cancellation terms
Retrieve the reservation and reconcile its final status
Retrieve or generate a voucher only when applicable to a confirmed reservation
workflows.OTHER_METHODS: Static lookups, authorization, balance, voucher and amendment paths must be mapped to the entitled account contract by TBO.

HOTEL_SEARCH.authentication: TBO-issued hotel API Basic Auth; send credentials securely outside this file.
notes: Hotel codes come from current TBO static data.
The eight occupancy cases contain their own Search bodies; preserve each room's occupancy.

HOTEL_PREBOOK.authentication: TBO-issued hotel API Basic Auth, subject to account confirmation.
notes: Use a current bookable unit and review the returned amount, rules and guest-document requirements.

HOTEL_BOOK.authentication: TBO-issued hotel API authorization, as confirmed for this endpoint.
notes: This example has one adult in one room. For other cases generate the exact scenario guest/room mapping; designate one lead adult per room.
Replace NetAmount with the numeric value/type required by the entitled schema, not a placeholder string.
Populate required identity/tax fields only with TBO-approved synthetic test values and returned requirements.
Confirm RequestedBookingMode, reference limits, hold/voucher fields and any transport-related hotel fields with TBO.

HOTEL_RETRIEVE.authentication: Agreed session-token contract; confirm the endpoint family.
notes: Replace BookingId with an integer. Ask TBO to provide the supported fallback lookup when the booking response was lost; do not assume client-reference lookup is enabled.

HOTEL_CANCEL.authentication: Agreed session-token contract; confirm the endpoint family.
notes: Approved controlled staging cancellation only. Partial-room cancellation needs a separate TBO-confirmed schema and capability.

HOTEL_CANCEL_STATUS.authentication: Agreed session-token contract; confirm the endpoint family.
notes: Track the supplier's final decision and refund evidence independently; a submitted cancellation is not a settled refund.

evidence_required: redacted request and response JSON for each method
HTTP status, application error/status and elapsed time
session/trace/reference identifiers required by TBO, through the agreed channel
final retrieval and confirmation evidence for successful bookings
evidence_submission_note: After execution, submit each occupancy certification case separately with its actual method-level request/response logs and supplier confirmation evidence; a planning JSON file is not a substitute for those logs.

scenarios.title: City and hotel identifier mapping
scenarios.test_data: New city ID and hotel codes from current static feed; retired ID variant.
execution_steps: Resolve city → properties → search.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Current mappings and invalid/retired code response.
acceptance_criteria: No airport-code/city-ID confusion; retired property cannot silently map to another hotel.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Room combinations remain intact
scenarios.test_data: Two rooms, different adults/children and room types.
execution_steps: Search then select one bookable combination and the agreed hotel booking workflow.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Combination code, ordered room/guest mapping and per-room/whole-unit prices.
acceptance_criteria: Do not split or recombine rates from unrelated booking codes.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Child ages and occupancy limits
scenarios.test_data: Missing age, age-count mismatch, extra child, infant, no adult; positive control.
execution_steps: Local validation plus agreed Search/PreBook error fixtures.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Allowed ranges and supplier-specific occupancy/extra-bed conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Exact age at check-in preserved; no assumed free infant or guaranteed extra bed.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Stay/date boundaries
scenarios.test_data: Checkout same/before check-in, past stay, minimum stay, maximum stay, leap-day boundary.
execution_steps: Separate Search/PreBook variants.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Validation errors and supported date/stay limits.
acceptance_criteria: Nights calculated correctly; invalid stay cannot be booked.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Nationality/residency restrictions
scenarios.test_data: Same property/dates for IN and AE guest profiles; rate restricted to one.
execution_steps: Search and the agreed hotel booking workflow using actual declared nationality/residency.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Applicable rate/eligibility and mismatch rejection.
acceptance_criteria: Nationality not changed to obtain a cheaper rate; constraints visible to consultant.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Room-only versus meal plans
scenarios.test_data: Same hotel with room-only, breakfast and all-inclusive options.
execution_steps: Search/PreBook each distinct rate.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Exact meal inclusion, guest coverage and rate identifiers.
acceptance_criteria: Do not assume breakfast covers every guest or all-inclusive includes all extras.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Refundability and deadline boundary
scenarios.test_data: Refundable/non-refundable; cancellation one minute before/after deadline.
execution_steps: PreBook; quote applicable cancellation charge in separate fixtures.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Policy ladder, timezone, indexed room scope, fixed/percent/night rules.
acceptance_criteria: Correct policy presented for selected rate; no inferred timezone or free cancellation.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Price changes at PreBook
scenarios.test_data: Higher/lower total, changed tax or supplement since Search.
execution_steps: Search → PreBook → review.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Updated cost/currency and whether new booking code is returned/required.
acceptance_criteria: Reconcile final amount; require review before Book.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Policy changes without price change
scenarios.test_data: Same total; refundable becomes restricted or meal inclusion changes.
execution_steps: Search then changed PreBook fixture.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Changed policy/inclusions and validity metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Terms change triggers review even when total is unchanged.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Selected room no longer available
scenarios.test_data: Search success; room sold out or booking code expires.
execution_steps: PreBook/Book controlled failure; retrieve if commit outcome uncertain.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Sold-out/expired code and permitted re-search path.
acceptance_criteria: No different hotel/room substituted automatically; no false confirmation.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Taxes, supplements and currency
scenarios.test_data: Multi-room stay; included tax, pay-at-property city fee and extra guest charge.
execution_steps: Search → PreBook → confirmed retrieval.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Charge scope, currency, inclusion flags, nightly/total values and settlement amount.
acceptance_criteria: No double-counted tax; payable-now and payable-at-property clearly separated.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Minimum selling restriction
scenarios.test_data: Rate with RecommendedSellingRate, zero/absent variant and currency mismatch.

scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Restriction applicability and authoritative currency/amount semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Applicable floor enforced; never convert or omit it without an agreed rule.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Mandatory PAN/passport/GST/name fields
scenarios.test_data: PreBook varies document flags and guest naming restrictions.
execution_steps: the agreed hotel booking workflow with one missing/invalid field per variant, then corrected payload.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Required-field flags, supported formats, rejection code and accepted guest mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Collect required data securely; no invented identifiers; validation follows returned rules.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Package-only rate and transfers

execution_steps: PreBook then Book with valid/omitted details.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Package restrictions, transport fields and transfer coverage/charges.
acceptance_criteria: No package-only rate sold standalone; transfers not promised from hotel description alone.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Special requests and accessibility
scenarios.test_data: Twin beds, adjoining rooms, late arrival, wheelchair-accessible room.
execution_steps: Submit only supported request fields; retrieve.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Accepted request versus guaranteed amenity; unsupported field response.
acceptance_criteria: Requested features remain unconfirmed unless explicit supplier evidence supports them.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Booking pending/on request
scenarios.test_data: Book accepted but supplier confirmation delayed.
execution_steps: the agreed hotel booking workflow then agreed polling/status retrieval.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Pending→confirmed and pending→failed sequences with polling guidance.
acceptance_criteria: No voucher or confirmed notice while pending; timeout escalates to consultant.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Timeout after Book
scenarios.test_data: Supplier created reservation but response lost; alternate no-booking variant.
execution_steps: LOCAL response loss with TBO reconciliation fixtures.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Lookup using client reference/session/known IDs; eventual final states.
acceptance_criteria: No blind duplicate reservation; unresolved stays unknown.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Duplicate and concurrent hotel Book
scenarios.test_data: Two identical requests, same room code/reference.
execution_steps: LOCAL concurrency test and approved staging duplicate fixture.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Deduplication contract, duplicate error or existing reservation retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: One logical reservation; de-duplication does not block a deliberate separate booking.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Multi-room partial failure

scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Document whether whole unit fails or partial reservation exists; exact financial state.
acceptance_criteria: Never assume atomicity; reconcile and display every room’s actual status.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.test_data: Confirmed reservation; pending state; duplicate voucher request.
execution_steps: GetBookingDetails and GenerateVoucher where applicable.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Voucher availability, confirmation/reference fields and premature-request error.
acceptance_criteria: Voucher reflects confirmed dates, guests and room scope; no duplicate booking from reprint.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Full/partial cancellation
scenarios.test_data: Whole booking and one room; free/penalty/non-refundable variants.
execution_steps: Approved cancel/change path → status → retrieve.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Supported scope, charge, request/final status and remaining rooms.
acceptance_criteria: No automatic full cancellation when partial unsupported; reconcile deductions.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Amendment, shortening and extension
scenarios.test_data: Guest correction, arrival shift, one-night shortening/extension.
execution_steps: Use supported amendment or explicit cancel/rebook alternative.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Availability, fare/policy changes and unsupported operation response.
acceptance_criteria: Never treat an email request as supplier-approved change; re-approve costs.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: No-show, early checkout and refund
scenarios.test_data: Confirmed stay not used or guest leaves early.
execution_steps: Use supplier-supported change/refund status workflow.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Policy outcome, penalty, approved/refused refund and settlement evidence.
acceptance_criteria: No promised refund without supplier outcome; avoid duplicate financial posting.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.title: Stale/missing booking details
scenarios.test_data: Unknown reference, eventual consistency, changed supplier status.
execution_steps: Retrieve using supported identifiers and bounded retries.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Not-found versus pending versus final failure; updated booking details.
acceptance_criteria: Do not mark cancelled from transient not-found; escalate unresolved mismatch.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Hotel service authorization succeeds
scenarios.test_data: TBO-issued hotel staging login, approved agency profile and whitelisted egress IP.
execution_steps: Authorize each entitled hotel service and call an enabled hotel read method. Use Basic Auth or a session token only where specified for that service.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Successful authorization/read examples for the hotel account; session expiry metadata where applicable. Supply credentials separately.
acceptance_criteria: Static-content access and hotel availability access are verified independently; no secret is included in the sharing pack.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Invalid or incomplete hotel credentials
scenarios.test_data: Incorrect hotel credentials, omitted required authentication value, and incorrect agency/profile identifier as separate variants.
execution_steps: Make one TBO-approved negative request per variant, followed by a corrected request.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: The exact authorization errors and the supported correction procedure.
acceptance_criteria: A rejected identity cannot proceed to a hotel reservation; distinguish authentication failure from zero availability.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Hotel session or selection expires
scenarios.test_data: Expired session token where required, and a selected hotel BookingCode that has expired.
execution_steps: Test the session-based method and stale selection separately; follow the account-specific renewal and re-search procedure.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Expiry errors, applicable lifetimes and approved recovery paths.
acceptance_criteria: Do not apply token renewal rules to Basic Auth calls; refresh expired selections and reconcile any uncertain booking first.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Hotel account entitlement denied
scenarios.test_data: Static hotel content is accessible but Search, PreBook or Book entitlement is not enabled.
execution_steps: Call each hotel service using its own entitled credentials and isolate the denied capability.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Entitlement-specific response and the account enablement procedure.
acceptance_criteria: A configuration/access error is not displayed as a successful search with no rooms.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Hotel egress IP or agency profile rejected
scenarios.test_data: TBO-approved allowed and denied IP/profile fixtures.
execution_steps: Use TBO-controlled denial fixtures; verify a corrected hotel request with the approved egress IP.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: The exact rejection and diagnostic fields, plus whitelisting requirements.
acceptance_criteria: The rejection is actionable and no reservation is reported as confirmed.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Hotel throttling or temporary read outage
scenarios.test_data: Controlled rate-limit, timeout and service-unavailable fixtures; no uncontrolled load test.
execution_steps: Exercise Search or static lookup with bounded retries under TBO's documented policy.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: HTTP/application errors, retry headers and permitted retry intervals.
acceptance_criteria: Back off within the request deadline; never convert an outage into a no-availability result.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Insufficient hotel wallet or credit
scenarios.test_data: Staging credit below the selected hotel's final amount.
execution_steps: Use balance lookup if supported, then one approved hotel Book attempt and authoritative reconciliation.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Insufficient-credit response, any debit/release details, and the final reservation state.
acceptance_criteria: No false confirmation, repeated debit or blind booking retry.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.

scenarios.section: C. Hotel access and API resilience
scenarios.title: Malformed, partial or interrupted hotel response
scenarios.test_data: Separate fixtures for a business error in HTTP 200, missing required field, invalid JSON and a lost response.
execution_steps: Use TBO fixtures or local fault injection at read and booking boundaries.
scenarios.requested_tbo_fixture: Documented error contracts and a reconciliation fixture for uncertain Book results.
acceptance_criteria: Reject incomplete success data. Preserve an unknown booking outcome until supplier retrieval resolves it.
scenarios.requirement_basis: TLC-proposed hotel test coverage; confirm applicability with TBO.
